verdict.rationale: Angular's docs claim it builds fast, reliable applications that scale with team size. They point to Signals for fine-grained reactivity, components plus dependency injection for modular organization, integrated first-party modules, and a style guide. Community reports corroborate this: production apps with good performance from AOT and tree-shaking, and Google apps over 100k SLOC with no major maintenance issues when the style guide was followed. The $digest slowdowns reported with large bindings concern legacy AngularJS, not current Angular, so they do not contradict the claim. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on large-app architecture and performance (the cited items are mostly marketing taglines), and recent independent hands-on evidence for modern Angular at large scale.
